explanation: A title used for God, referring to his sovereignty and authority over all creation.
The process by which God saves and delivers his people from sin, suffering, and oppression.
A name for Jerusalem, especially the holy part of the city where the temple stood. It symbolizes God's presence and serves as the center of worship for his people.
To shake off sleep or indifference, becoming alert and active. Used here as a call to God's people to wake up and recognize God's actions.
Often used symbolically in the Bible to represent one's journey or path in life. In this context, it refers to those who bring good news of God's salvation.
The message of God's salvation and deliverance for his people, including the promise of a restored relationship with him.
To be set apart from what is common or profane, dedicated to God and his service.
